info.title: Platform RP and Accounts identity session events
info.description: Local opt-in logout and changes-v1 invalidation stream. All events trigger a current-Cookie view read. No page replay cursor. Explicit events-v1 negotiation plus successful reconciliation suspends legacy polling only while the stream is healthy.

get.summary: Subscribe to current-session logout, context and authorization invalidation
get.description: Requires RP_SESSION_EVENTS_ENABLED and durable logout recovery. No query parameters are accepted. Origin, if provided, must match the configured RP origin. Sec-Fetch-Site, if provided, must be same-origin or none. Each connection authenticates again and subscribes before its final session reads. NOTIFY only triggers a durable state recheck; it is never a logout fact. The stream closes on transport loss, slow-reader backpressure or the earlier of the existing Redis expiry and recovered central absolute expiry. No stream operation extends the session lifetime. Missing Origin/Fetch Metadata is permitted for non-browser clients but never replaces Cookie authentication. Error response bodies are not a stable event contract; branch on the HTTP status. With RP_IDENTITY_CHANGES_ENABLED, context-changed and access-changed are emitted only after reading a changed durable version; changes for other subjects are excluded. Notifications never supply permissions or replacement contexts. Console, Website, Admin, Opera, Arche and Workbench use their configured RP cookie. Customer Portal uses __Host-vx_customer_portal_session and retains the exact published hostname and tenant/workspace binding. Workforce emits access changes and logout only. Notifications never replace a pinned portal context.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: Accepted only up to 512 characters and ignored by logout-v1. No event id is emitted. Reconnects always authenticate and reread state; there is no page event replay.

200.description: Authenticated SSE stream. connected is sent first; revoked or expired is followed by close. Every recognized event triggers a current-Cookie session read, never a direct identity mutation.

X-Vxture-Session-Sync.description: Optional. Present only with explicit RP_SESSION_POLLING_RETIREMENT_ENABLED and complete changes/recovery/SSE wiring. Client must also successfully reconcile the connected event before suppressing periodic/focus/visibility reads. Disconnect, invalid frames, missing heartbeats or unavailable view restore legacy fallback. Absence never authorizes polling retirement.

204.description: Optional stream disabled. No Cookie authentication is performed after the origin/parameter checks. Stop the optional stream without clearing identity.

400.description: Query parameters or an oversized Last-Event-ID. Stop the optional stream without clearing identity.

401.description: No valid session for this connection. Recheck /auth/session with the current Cookie; clear identity only after a confirmed anonymous result.

403.description: Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site rejected. Stop the optional stream without clearing identity.

429.description: Connection budget exceeded (5000 per process or 32 per sid). Retry with bounded backoff.

503.description: Listener, Redis, durable state or authentication recovery unavailable. Preserve identity display and reconnect with backoff. Protected requests remain independently authenticated.

context-changed.description: Durable version changed; reread the current Cookie session.

access-changed.description: Durable version changed; reread the current Cookie session.

get.summary: Read central Accounts invalidation hints for the current realm cookie
get.description: Requires ACCOUNTS_SESSION_EVENTS_ENABLED; workforce additionally requires WORKFORCE_IDENTITY_SYNC_ENABLED. The required realm selector chooses vx_sid (customer) or vx_sid_op (workforce); the other cookie never substitutes. Rejects all other query fields. Sec-Fetch-Site must be same-origin. Origin, if present, must equal the configured issuer or login UI origin. Resolve the realm authority before and after subscribing, then check durable owner and expiry. Only resync-required hints are sent, without identity, permissions or tokens. Heartbeats every 25 seconds perform no authority reads. Disconnect, expiry or backpressure closes the stream. Every reconnect and notification triggers a complete current-cookie view read. No replay cursor and no extension of session lifetime.

200.description: Authenticated stream of resync-required events, whose JSON data matches AccountsResyncData

503.description: Authority or notification channel unavailable; retain identity and retry

consoleSessionCookie.name: __Host-vx_rp_session_console
consoleSessionCookie.description: Existing HttpOnly RP Cookie. This name is for HTTPS client_id=console; configured client_id replaces the suffix. Local insecure HTTP uses vx_rp_session_<client_id>. The endpoint does not set a Cookie or accept a URL token.

customerPortalCookie.name: __Host-vx_customer_portal_session
customerPortalCookie.description: Existing host-only customer portal session cookie; accepted only by that host adapter.
